product.name: Sales Commission Automation Software
product.description: Software that automates the calculation, management, and payout of sales commissions based on defined rules and real-time data.

product.name: Real-Time Commission Tracking and Dashboards
product.description: Provides sales teams and managers with real-time visibility into commission accruals and payouts through personalized dashboards.

product.name: Commission Plan Designer and Simulator
product.description: Tool to design, simulate, compare, and optimize sales commission plans with complex calculation logic.

product.name: Revenue Reconciliation with CRM and Billing Data
product.description: Feature that reconciles invoices and payments from billing systems with CRM data to ensure commissions are paid only on collected revenue.
